name: tablewriter-state
instr:
I'm restoring the colorized terminal renderer in our copy of go-tablewriter. We use it for CLI output where headers, rows and footers need their own colors, and right now the stubs in `renderer/colorized.go` panic, so any table configured with `renderer.NewColorized` blows up. `NewColorized` is the entry point; the rest of the `Colorized` methods (config, header, row, footer, line drawing, start) hang off it. Could you implement them so the renderer works with the rest of the package?

The doc comments on those methods are the contract, so please follow them closely; the output goes straight to people's terminals and into snapshot comparisons.

Please keep every exported name and signature as it is; private helpers are up to you. I'll run the repository's own tests against it, and the rest of the module's tests must keep passing.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname` or `//go:embed` directives; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess` and `runtime.Goexit`; reading `os.Args`, `os.Executable`, `/proc/self` or `runtime/debug` build info; caller or stack lookups (`runtime.Caller`, `Callers`, `CallersFrames`, `FuncForPC`, `Stack`, `debug.Stack`, `debug.PrintStack`, `log.Lshortfile`, `log.Llongfile`, and any field or key named `AddSource`); and printing test-runner
